title: In 2008, a collector spotted an unusual Eisenhower dollar inside a tube of ordinary coins
summary_full: A fascinating discovery has emerged, as a rare 1971 Eisenhower dollar prototype coin is set to hit the auction block once more. Found tucked away in an inconspicuous tube of standard coins, this remarkable piece is one of only three surviving prototypes from the United States Mint's inaugural space-themed dollar. Originally selling for $264,000 in 2008, this unique coin will see bids close on October 18, 2026.
